words.sense: remain indecisive while alternating between choices or opinions
misconceptions: Confusing repeated physical movement with an unresolved decision.

words.sense: move back and forth repeatedly between positions or values
misconceptions: Treating human indecision as only a regular mechanical cycle.

semantic_axes.description: Vacillate means waver about what to decide; oscillate means repeatedly move or vary between positions or values.

edges.boundary_rule: Vacillate means waver about what to decide; oscillate means repeatedly move or vary between positions or values.

misconceptions.M1: Confuses vacillate with oscillate by overlooking the defining difference: Vacillate means waver about what to decide; oscillate means repeatedly move or vary between positions or values.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes evidence for oscillate necessarily proves vacillate; these are different tests.
misconceptions.M3: Overweights a later superficial detail instead of retaining or appropriately updating the original boundary evidence.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Yara’s choice of study program?

beats.text: Yara changed her intended major from law to design and back twice without submitting an application.
beats.decisive_clue: repeatedly shifts between options without deciding
beats.reason: She is unable to commit to a decision.

beats.text: After another conversation, she reopened both forms and postponed choosing again.
beats.decisive_clue: postpones committing even after revisiting both options
beats.reason: Reopening both forms confirms the continuing indecision.

chains.feedback_short: Postpones committing even after revisiting both options; reopening both forms confirms the continuing indecision.
chains.feedback_deep: Vacillate means remain indecisive while alternating between choices or opinions; oscillate means move back and forth repeatedly between positions or values. Reopening both forms confirms the continuing indecision.
chains.contrast_rule: Vacillate means waver about what to decide; oscillate means repeatedly move or vary between positions or values.
